visual.general_description: Eight echocardiogram panels (A to H), four transthoracic and four transesophageal, each pair showing a plain view and the same view with colour Doppler.
visual.detailed_description: A 4 by 2 grid. Row 1 (A, B) and row 2 (C, D) are orange-brown transthoracic images; rows 3 and 4 (E to H) are black-and-white transesophageal images. Within each row the left panel is a plain image and the right panel the same view with a colour Doppler box. Rows 1 and 3 are short-axis views with a ring-shaped prosthesis; rows 2 and 4 are long-axis views with a broad mosaic-coloured jet in the colour panels. Each panel carries printed scanner text, a green ECG trace and a heart rate readout, and a panel letter in a white box at the lower left. No patient name, date or identification number is visible.

visual.general_description: Six-panel multimodality assessment: echocardiographic measurements (A, B), angiography (C), CT (D), CMR (E) and a CMR flow-time chart with printed regurgitant volume and fraction (F).
visual.detailed_description: Top row: A, a transesophageal short-axis colour Doppler image with printed caliper text, and B, a rendered 3D colour Doppler image with a printed distance. Middle row: C, a fluoroscopic angiographic image with a stent-frame valve and a red arrow; D, a CT image with bright metallic-density lines and a red arrow; E, a cardiac MR image with a red arrow. Bottom: F, a wide flow-versus-time chart in red with printed regurgitant volume and fraction and a small phase-contrast inset. Panel letters are printed in white boxes at the lower left of each panel. Panels A and B carry a partly cut-off date and time stamp at the top edge (category only; values not transcribed); no patient name or identification number is visible.

panels.detailed_description: A greyscale sector image with a bright ring-shaped prosthesis and a colour Doppler box. Small blue, yellow and red colour patches lie at the upper centre of the ring. Printed measurement text at the lower right lists two caliper readings, each labelled "Circ" with a length in cm and "Area" with an area in cm²: "Circ 3.33 cm", "Area 0.359 cm²", "Circ 1.21 cm", "Area 0.090 cm²". A probe angle indicator, scanner text, a colour velocity scale and a green ECG trace with a heart rate readout are printed; the label "A" is in a white box at the lower left.
